names.note: Read out of the title on the name link in the line for 20 ноября ст. ст., name page 13863, «Николай (Покровский), иерей, сщмч.», with the grade and rank words left off; the day line itself gives the forename declined and no surname at all. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts no fold for it, and `.tmp/rusurn.py` was run over the surname: every folder it returned carries a different forename. The sweep over Покровский returned five folders — `alexander-pokrovsky`, `basil-pokrovsky`, `john-pokrovsky`, `sergius-pokrovsky` and `vladimir-pokrovsky` — and not one of them is a Николай.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 ноября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Алексия, Александра, Владимира, Иоанна, Алексия, Василия, Николая, Иоанна, Емилиана, Николая пресвитеров, и прмчч. Арсения, Евтихия и Илариона, прмц. Иоанникии игумении (1937).»

attestations.note: days.pravoslavie.ru heads the name page with two days and no more: 26 января, marked «(Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the New Martyrs, and 20 ноября. Only the second was read, and only the second is a row. **azbyka.ru has no page for him and its day index links to the wrong man.** Its line for the civil 3 декабря names «Николая Покровского» in plain text with no link, and the slug `sv-nikolaj-pokrovskij` on that site is a different Nicholas Pokrovsky altogether: born in 1864, a Simbirsk seminarian, and kept on «18 марта» and the synaxis of the saints of Simbirsk, with no 3 декабря among his days at all. The only text read for this folder is the shared article on the Tikhvin case, which names him among the seven, and it is cited from the page of the dean the article is written about.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's list for 3 decembrie, the corresponding civil day (6 October 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 20 ноября ст. ст. with «(1937)», which it gives to the whole company of fourteen; the article azbyka.ru prints out of pstgu.ru closes «были расстреляны в Тихвине 3 декабря 1937 года», and 3 декабря 1937 is the civil day of this Julian 20 November. No day is recorded here because this corpus’s `dates` are years, and no year of birth is given for this person anywhere read.
